source.text: שַׁאֲל֨וּ מֵיְהוָ֤ה מָטָר֙ בְּעֵ֣ת מַלְק֔וֹשׁ יְהוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֣ה חֲזִיזִ֑ים וּמְטַר־גֶּ֨שֶׁם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם לְאִ֖ישׁ עֵ֥שֶׂב בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Ask from Yahweh rain in [the] time of [the] spring rain; Yahweh [is] making storm clouds, and showers of rain he gives to them, to each [one the] vegetation in the field.

en.L: Ask rain from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in the time of the spring rain; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is the one] making the storm clouds, \q and showers of rain {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives to them, \q to everyone the vegetation in the field.
en.B: Ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for rain in the season of the spring rain. \q It is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who makes the storm clouds; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives them showers of rain \q and green plants in the field for everyone.
en.R: Ask {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for rain in the spring. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is the one who makes the storm clouds. \q He sends showers of rain \q and makes the plants in the fields grow for everyone.

es.L: {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} lluvia {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en el tiempo de la lluvia tardía; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [es el que] hace los nubarrones, \q y aguaceros de lluvia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les da, \q a cada uno la hierba en el campo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Pidan|Pedid}} lluvia {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en la estación de las lluvias de primavera. \q Es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien forma los nubarrones; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les da aguaceros \q y hierba verde en el campo para todos.
es.R: {{plural_you:Pídanle|Pedidle}} lluvia {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en la primavera. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es quien forma las nubes de tormenta. \q Él manda los aguaceros \q y hace crecer las plantas en los campos para todos.

fr.L: Demandez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} de la pluie au temps de la pluie tardive ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est celui qui] fait les nuées d’orage, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur donne des averses de pluie, \q à chacun l’herbe dans le champ.
fr.B: Demandez la pluie {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} à la saison des pluies de printemps. \q C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui forme les nuées d’orage ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur donne des averses \q et l’herbe verte des champs pour chacun.
fr.R: Demandez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} de la pluie au printemps. \q C’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui fait les nuages d’orage. \q Il envoie les averses \q et fait pousser les plantes des champs pour tout le monde.

sw.L: Ombeni mvua kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wakati wa mvua za masika; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ndiye] afanyaye mawingu ya radi, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} huwapa manyunyu ya mvua, \q kila mtu majani ya shambani.
sw.B: Mwombeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mvua wakati wa mvua za masika. \q Ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} afanyaye mawingu ya dhoruba; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} huwapa manyunyu ya mvua \q na mimea mibichi shambani kwa ajili ya kila mtu.
sw.R: Mwombeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mvua wakati wa masika. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye anayefanya mawingu ya dhoruba. \q Yeye huleta manyunyu ya mvua \q na huotesha mimea mashambani kwa ajili ya kila mtu.

vi.L: Hãy cầu xin mưa nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào mùa mưa xuân; \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] làm ra mây giông, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho họ những trận mưa rào, \q cho mỗi người cỏ cây ngoài đồng.
vi.B: Hãy cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban mưa vào mùa mưa xuân. \q Chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm ra mây giông; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho họ mưa rào \q và cây cỏ xanh tươi ngoài đồng cho mọi người.
vi.R: Hãy cầu xin {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho mưa vào mùa xuân. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng làm ra mây giông. \q Ngài đổ mưa rào xuống \q và làm cho cây cỏ ngoài đồng mọc lên cho mọi người.

ko.L: 봄비가 내릴 때에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 비를 구하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 먹구름을 만드시고, \q 그들에게 소나기를 주시며, \q 각 사람에게 들의 풀을 [주신다].
ko.B: 봄비 철에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 비를 내려 달라고 구하여라. \q 먹구름을 만드시는 분은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다. \q 그분께서 그들에게 소나기를 주시고 \q 모든 사람에게 들의 푸른 풀을 주신다.
ko.R: 봄에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 비를 내려 달라고 구하여라. \q 비구름을 만드시는 분은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다. \q 그분께서 소나기를 내려 주시고 \q 모든 사람을 위해 들에 풀이 자라게 하신다.

decisions.choice: the spring rain: the last rains of the season, in March and April
decisions.reason: In the land of Israel rain falls only in the winter half of the year. The early rain of autumn softens the ground for plowing, and the late rain of spring swells the grain before harvest (Deuteronomy 11:14; Joel 2:23). Without the spring rain the harvest failed.

decisions.choice: ask rain from the LORD: the LORD, not the idols, gives the rain
decisions.reason: Many in Israel had looked to Baal, the storm god of Canaan, or to household gods and diviners, for rain and harvest (verse 2; Hosea 2:7-10; Jeremiah 14:22). The prophet calls the people to ask the LORD, who makes the storm clouds and gives the rain. It is a call back to trust in him.

decisions.choice: storm clouds: the thunderclouds that bring rain
decisions.reason: The word is used for the thunderbolt or the storm cloud that goes before the rain (Job 28:26; 38:25). The LORD makes the storm and sends the showers.

decisions.choice: It is the LORD who makes (B); green plants ... grow (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts the LORD's name first for emphasis, which Balanced gives as "It is the LORD who" and Readable as "The LORD is the one who". Balanced and Readable say "green plants" for the field's vegetation.

decisions.choice: "la lluvia tardía" (L); "las lluvias de primavera" (B); "la primavera" (R)
alternatives: "la lluvia de primavera" at every level
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the traditional name of the late rain of spring (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable name the season.

decisions.choice: "mvua za masika" (L, B); "masika" (R) for the spring rain
decisions.reason: In East Africa the long rains of March to May are "masika", the same season as the spring rain of meaning decision m1; "vuli" are the short rains of the autumn.

decisions.choice: "구하여라" to the people; "만드시고", "주신다" with -시- for the LORD
decisions.reason: The prophet speaks here about the LORD, so the LORD takes the honorific; from verse 3 the LORD himself speaks and takes none. "봄비" names the spring rain plainly rather than the older "늦은 비".

source.text: כִּ֧י הַתְּרָפִ֣ים דִּבְּרוּ־אָ֗וֶן וְהַקּֽוֹסְמִים֙ חָ֣זוּ שֶׁ֔קֶר וַֽחֲלֹמוֹת֙ הַשָּׁ֣ואיְדַבֵּ֔רוּ הֶ֖בֶל יְנַֽחֵמ֑וּן עַל־כֵּן֙ נָסְע֣וּ כְמוֹ־צֹ֔אן יַעֲנ֖וּ כִּֽי־אֵ֥ין רֹעֶֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For the teraphim speak wickedness, and the diviners see falsehood, and dreams of worthlessness they speak, [with] futility they comfort; therefore they set out like sheep, they are afflicted, for there is no shepherd.

en.L: For the teraphim speak wickedness, and the diviners see falsehood; \q and they speak worthless dreams; \q they comfort in vain. \q Therefore they set out like sheep; \q they are afflicted, for there is no shepherd.
en.B: For the household gods speak deceit, and the diviners see lies; \q they tell dreams that are false \q and give comfort that is empty. \q So the people wander off like sheep; \q they suffer because they have no shepherd.
en.R: The household idols give answers that cannot be trusted, and the fortune-tellers see visions that are lies. \q They tell dreams that mean nothing. \q The comfort they give is useless. \q So the people wander like lost sheep. \q They suffer because they have no shepherd to lead them.

es.L: Porque los terafines hablan iniquidad, y los adivinos ven mentira; \q y sueños vanos cuentan, \q en vano consuelan. \q Por eso parten como ovejas; \q están afligidos, porque no hay pastor.
es.B: Porque los ídolos familiares dicen engaños, y los adivinos ven mentiras; \q cuentan sueños falsos \q y dan un consuelo vacío. \q Por eso el pueblo anda errante como ovejas; \q sufre porque no tiene pastor.
es.R: Los ídolos de la casa dan respuestas en las que no se puede confiar, y los adivinos ven visiones que son mentira. \q Cuentan sueños que no significan nada. \q El consuelo que dan no sirve de nada. \q Por eso el pueblo anda como ovejas perdidas. \q Sufre porque no tiene un pastor que lo guíe.

fr.L: Car les téraphim disent la fausseté, et les devins voient le mensonge ; \q ils racontent des rêves vides, \q ils consolent en vain. \q C’est pourquoi ils s’en vont comme des brebis ; \q ils sont affligés, car il n’y a pas de berger.
fr.B: Car les dieux domestiques disent des tromperies, et les devins voient des mensonges ; \q ils racontent des rêves trompeurs \q et donnent une consolation vide. \q Alors le peuple erre comme des brebis ; \q il souffre parce qu’il n’a pas de berger.
fr.R: Les idoles de la maison donnent des réponses auxquelles on ne peut pas se fier, et les devins ont des visions mensongères. \q Ils racontent des rêves qui ne veulent rien dire. \q Le réconfort qu’ils donnent ne sert à rien. \q Alors le peuple erre comme des moutons perdus. \q Il souffre parce qu’il n’a pas de berger pour le conduire.

sw.L: Kwa maana terafimu wamesema uovu, na waaguzi wameona uongo; \q nao husema ndoto za ubatili, \q hufariji bure. \q Kwa hiyo wanaondoka kama kondoo; \q wanateseka, kwa sababu hakuna mchungaji.
sw.B: Kwa maana miungu ya nyumbani husema udanganyifu, na waaguzi huona uongo; \q husimulia ndoto za uongo \q na kutoa faraja isiyo na maana. \q Kwa hiyo watu wanatangatanga kama kondoo; \q wanateseka kwa sababu hawana mchungaji.
sw.R: Sanamu za nyumbani hutoa majibu yasiyoaminika, na waaguzi huona maono ya uongo. \q Husimulia ndoto zisizo na maana yoyote. \q Faraja wanayotoa haifai kitu. \q Kwa hiyo watu wanatangatanga kama kondoo waliopotea. \q Wanateseka kwa sababu hawana mchungaji wa kuwaongoza.

vi.L: Vì các thê-ra-phim nói điều gian ác, và các thầy bói thấy điều giả dối; \q họ kể những giấc mơ hư không, \q họ an ủi cách vô ích. \q Vì vậy họ ra đi như chiên; \q họ khốn khổ, vì không có người chăn.
vi.B: Vì các tượng thần gia đình nói lời dối gạt, và các thầy bói thấy điều dối trá; \q họ kể những giấc mơ giả tạo \q và an ủi bằng lời trống rỗng. \q Vì thế dân chúng đi lang thang như bầy chiên; \q họ chịu khổ vì không có người chăn.
vi.R: Các tượng thần trong nhà đưa ra những lời đáp không thể tin được, và các thầy bói thấy những khải tượng dối trá. \q Họ kể những giấc mơ chẳng có ý nghĩa gì. \q Lời an ủi của họ chẳng giúp được gì. \q Vì thế dân chúng đi lang thang như chiên lạc. \q Họ chịu khổ vì không có người chăn dẫn dắt họ.

ko.L: 참으로 드라빔은 악한 것을 말하고, 점쟁이들은 거짓을 보며, \q 헛된 꿈을 말하고, \q 헛되이 위로한다. \q 그러므로 그들이 양 떼처럼 떠나가고, \q 목자가 없어 괴로움을 당한다.
ko.B: 집안 신상들은 속이는 말을 하고, 점쟁이들은 거짓을 보며, \q 거짓된 꿈을 이야기하고 \q 헛된 위로를 준다. \q 그래서 백성이 양 떼처럼 헤매고, \q 목자가 없어 고통을 당한다.
ko.R: 집 안의 우상들은 믿을 수 없는 대답을 하고, 점쟁이들은 거짓 환상을 본다. \q 그들은 아무 뜻도 없는 꿈을 이야기한다. \q 그들이 주는 위로는 쓸모가 없다. \q 그래서 백성이 길 잃은 양처럼 헤맨다. \q 그들을 이끌 목자가 없어서 고통을 당한다.

decisions.choice: the teraphim: household images used to seek guidance
decisions.reason: Teraphim were small images kept in the home (Genesis 31:19, 34) and used to ask for oracles (Ezekiel 21:26). They were condemned with other forms of divination (1 Samuel 15:23; 2 Kings 23:24). The meaning of the name is not known.

decisions.choice: the diviners see falsehood; dreams of worthlessness: the sources the people turned to for guidance are empty
decisions.reason: Diviners claimed to learn the future by signs and omens, a practice the law forbade (Deuteronomy 18:10-14). Dreams could come from God, but the prophets warned against those who told dreams of their own making (Jeremiah 23:25-32; 27:9). What these give is falsehood and "vapor", the word Ecclesiastes uses for what is fleeting and empty.

decisions.choice: like sheep with no shepherd: a people without true leaders
decisions.reason: A flock without a shepherd wanders and comes to harm. The picture is used of Israel without a king or a faithful leader (Numbers 27:17; 1 Kings 22:17; Ezekiel 34:5). In Matthew 9:36 and Mark 6:34 Jesus has compassion on the crowds because they are "like sheep without a shepherd".

decisions.choice: household gods (B); household idols (R); the people wander (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "teraphim"; Balanced and Readable say "household gods" and "household idols", as in Hosea 3:4. Balanced and Readable name "the people" as the ones who wander, which the Hebrew leaves to the context.

decisions.choice: "waaguzi" for the diviners
decisions.reason: The diviner's craft is "uaguzi" in Deuteronomy 18:10, the law that forbids it (meaning decision m2).

source.text: עַל־הָֽרֹעִים֙ חָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔י וְעַל־הָעַתּוּדִ֖ים אֶפְק֑וֹד כִּֽי־פָקַד֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֤וֹת אֶת־עֶדְרוֹ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה וְשָׂ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם כְּס֥וּס הוֹד֖וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Against the shepherds burns my anger, and on the male goats I will bring punishment; for Yahweh of hosts visits his flock, the house of Judah, and he will make them like his majestic horse in battle.

en.L: Against the shepherds {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger burns, \q and on the male goats I will visit [punishment]; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts has visited {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock, the house of Judah, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will set them like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} majestic horse in battle.
en.B: My anger blazes against the shepherds, \q and I will punish those who lead the flock; \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies cares for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock, the house of Judah, \q and will make them like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} proud war horse in battle.
en.R: I am angry with the shepherds who lead {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, \q and I will punish those leaders. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies takes care of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} flock, the people of Judah. \q He will make them like {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} proud horse in battle.

es.L: Contra los pastores arde {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira, \q y a los machos cabríos visitaré [con castigo]; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos ha visitado a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rebaño, la casa de Judá, \q y los pondrá como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} caballo de gala en la batalla.
es.B: Mi ira arde contra los pastores, \q y castigaré a los que guían el rebaño; \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos cuida de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rebaño, la casa de Judá, \q y hará de ellos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} orgulloso caballo de guerra en la batalla.
es.R: Estoy enojado con los pastores que guían a {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, \q y castigaré a esos líderes. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos cuida de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rebaño, el pueblo de Judá. \q Hará de ellos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} orgulloso caballo de batalla.

fr.L: Contre les bergers {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère s’enflamme, \q et les boucs, je [les] visiterai [pour les punir] ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées a visité {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau, la maison de Juda, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera d’eux comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} cheval de parade dans la bataille.
fr.B: Ma colère s’enflamme contre les bergers, \q et je punirai ceux qui mènent le troupeau ; \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées prend soin de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau, la maison de Juda, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera d’eux {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} fier cheval de guerre dans la bataille.
fr.R: Je suis en colère contre les bergers qui conduisent {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, \q et je punirai ces chefs. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées prend soin de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} troupeau, le peuple de Juda. \q Il fera d’eux comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} fier cheval de bataille.

sw.L: Juu ya wachungaji hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} inawaka, \q na mabeberu nitawajia [kwa adhabu]; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi amelijia kundi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, nyumba ya Yuda, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawafanya kama farasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa fahari vitani.
sw.B: Hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} inawaka dhidi ya wachungaji, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaadhibu wale wanaoliongoza kundi; \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analitunza kundi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, nyumba ya Yuda, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} atawafanya kama farasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wa vita mwenye fahari.
sw.R: Nimewakasirikia wachungaji wanaowaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawaadhibu viongozi hao. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi analitunza kundi {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, watu wa Yuda. \q Atawafanya kama farasi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} hodari wa vita.

vi.L: Nghịch cùng những người chăn, cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bừng cháy, \q và trên những con dê đực {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ thăm phạt; \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân đã thăm viếng bầy chiên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là nhà Giu-đa, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đặt họ như con ngựa oai phong của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong chiến trận.
vi.B: Cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bừng lên nghịch cùng những người chăn, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phạt những kẻ dẫn đầu bầy; \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân chăm sóc bầy chiên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là nhà Giu-đa, \q và sẽ làm cho họ như con chiến mã oai phong của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong trận chiến.
vi.R: Ta giận những người chăn đang dẫn dắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ phạt những kẻ lãnh đạo ấy. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân chăm sóc bầy chiên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là dân Giu-đa. \q Ngài sẽ làm cho họ như con ngựa chiến oai phong của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 목자들에게 내 진노가 타오르니, \q 숫염소들을 내가 찾아가 벌하겠다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 자기 양 떼 유다 집을 찾아와 돌보았으니, \q 그들을 전쟁터에서 자기의 위엄 있는 말처럼 세울 것이다.
ko.B: 내 진노가 목자들에게 타오르니, \q 양 떼를 이끄는 자들을 내가 벌하겠다. \q 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 자기 양 떼인 유다 집을 돌보아, \q 그들을 전쟁터의 늠름한 군마처럼 만들 것이다.
ko.R: 나는 내 백성을 이끄는 목자들에게 화가 났다. \q 그 지도자들을 내가 벌하겠다. \q 하늘의 군대를 거느린 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 자기 양 떼인 유다 백성을 돌본다. \q 그들을 전쟁터의 늠름한 말처럼 만들 것이다.

decisions.choice: the shepherds and the male goats: the leaders of the people
decisions.reason: In the ancient Near East kings and rulers were called shepherds of their people (Jeremiah 23:1-4; Ezekiel 34:2-10). The male goats lead the flock, and the word is used for leaders and chiefs (Isaiah 14:9; Ezekiel 34:17). These are the leaders who let the people wander (verse 2). The text does not say who they were.

decisions.choice: I will punish ... the LORD has visited: one verb, two senses
decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice. It means to look after someone, or to call someone to account. The LORD will call the leaders to account, and he has come to care for his flock. The play on the verb shows that his judgment on the leaders is his care for the people.

decisions.choice: like his majestic horse in battle: the weak flock becomes a war horse
decisions.reason: The sheep without a shepherd become the LORD's own war horse, splendid and fearless (Job 39:19-25). The LORD rides out to battle with his people (9:13-14).

decisions.choice: the male goats (L); the leaders of the flock (B); those leaders (R); the LORD of Armies (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "male goats"; Balanced and Readable say what they stand for (m1). "The LORD of hosts" follows the wording set in Isaiah. Readable says "my people" for the flock the shepherds lead; the LORD is speaking, so "my" takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "visitaré [con castigo]" ... "ha visitado" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one verb for both uses of the Hebrew verb, so the play of meaning decision m2 can be seen; Balanced and Readable say "castigar" and "cuidar de".

decisions.choice: "je [les] visiterai" ... "a visité" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one verb for the two senses of the Hebrew verb (meaning decision m2); Balanced and Readable say "punir" and "prendre soin de".

decisions.choice: "nitawajia" ... "amelijia" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one verb, "kujia" (to visit), for both senses (meaning decision m2); Balanced and Readable say "kuadhibu" and "kutunza".

decisions.choice: "thăm phạt" ... "thăm viếng" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the shared syllable "thăm" (visit) in both verbs, so the play of meaning decision m2 can be heard; Balanced and Readable say "phạt" and "chăm sóc".

decisions.choice: "만군의 주가 ... 돌보았으니", with no -시-
decisions.reason: The LORD is speaking and names himself in the third person (meaning decision m2), and God takes no honorific in his own mouth; Readable's title is "거느린", not "거느리신", for the same reason.

source.text: מִמֶּ֤נּוּ פִנָּה֙ מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יָתֵ֔ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֑ה מִמֶּ֛נּוּ יֵצֵ֥א כָל־נוֹגֵ֖שׂ יַחְדָּֽו׃

records.literal_gloss: From him [the] corner, from him [the] peg, from him [the] bow of battle; from him will go out every ruler together.

en.L: From him [will come the] cornerstone, from him [the] tent peg, \q from him [the] bow of battle; \q from him will go out every ruler together.
en.B: From Judah will come the cornerstone, from Judah the tent peg, \q from Judah the battle bow; \q from Judah every ruler will come.
en.R: From the people of Judah will come a leader like a cornerstone, and one like a tent peg, \q and one like a bow used in battle. \q Every ruler will come from them.

es.L: De él [saldrá la] piedra angular, de él [la] estaca, \q de él [el] arco de guerra; \q de él saldrá todo gobernante a una.
es.B: De Judá saldrá la piedra angular, de Judá la estaca de la tienda, \q de Judá el arco de guerra; \q de Judá saldrán todos los gobernantes.
es.R: Del pueblo de Judá saldrá un líder que será como una piedra angular, y otro como una estaca de tienda, \q y otro como un arco de guerra. \q De ellos saldrán todos los gobernantes.

fr.L: De lui [viendra la] pierre angulaire, de lui [le] piquet, \q de lui [l’]arc de guerre ; \q de lui sortiront tous les chefs ensemble.
fr.B: De Juda viendra la pierre angulaire, de Juda le piquet de la tente, \q de Juda l’arc de guerre ; \q de Juda sortiront tous les chefs.
fr.R: Du peuple de Juda viendra un chef qui sera comme une pierre angulaire, un autre comme un piquet de tente, \q et un autre comme un arc de guerre. \q Tous les chefs sortiront de ce peuple.

sw.L: Kutoka kwake [litatoka] jiwe la pembeni, kutoka kwake kigingi, \q kutoka kwake upinde wa vita; \q kutoka kwake atatoka kila mtawala pamoja.
sw.B: Kutoka Yuda litatoka jiwe la pembeni, kutoka Yuda kigingi cha hema, \q kutoka Yuda upinde wa vita; \q kutoka Yuda atatoka kila mtawala.
sw.R: Kutoka kwa watu wa Yuda atatokea kiongozi aliye kama jiwe la pembeni, na mwingine kama kigingi cha hema, \q na mwingine kama upinde wa vita. \q Kila mtawala atatoka kwao.

vi.L: Từ nó [sẽ ra] đá góc, từ nó cọc lều, \q từ nó cây cung chiến trận; \q từ nó mọi người cai trị sẽ cùng nhau ra đến.
vi.B: Từ Giu-đa sẽ ra đá góc nhà, từ Giu-đa ra cọc lều, \q từ Giu-đa ra cây cung chiến trận; \q từ Giu-đa mọi người cai trị sẽ xuất hiện.
vi.R: Từ dân Giu-đa sẽ xuất hiện một người lãnh đạo như đá góc nhà, một người như cọc lều, \q và một người như cây cung trong chiến trận. \q Mọi người cai trị đều sẽ ra từ họ.

ko.L: 그에게서 모퉁잇돌이, 그에게서 장막 말뚝이, \q 그에게서 전쟁의 활이 [나오고], \q 그에게서 모든 통치자가 함께 나올 것이다.
ko.B: 유다에게서 모퉁잇돌이 나오고, 유다에게서 장막 말뚝이 나오며, \q 유다에게서 전쟁의 활이 나오고, \q 유다에게서 모든 통치자가 나올 것이다.
ko.R: 유다 백성에게서 모퉁잇돌 같은 지도자와 장막 말뚝 같은 지도자가 나오고, \q 전쟁에 쓰는 활 같은 지도자가 나올 것이다. \q 모든 통치자가 그들에게서 나올 것이다.

decisions.choice: from him: from Judah
decisions.reason: "Him" refers back to the house of Judah in verse 3. The new leaders will come from God's people itself, in place of the shepherds who failed.

decisions.choice: the cornerstone, the tent peg, the battle bow: leaders who hold the people together and fight for them
decisions.reason: Each picture stands for a leader. The cornerstone holds up a building (Psalm 118:22; Isaiah 28:16), and "the corners" of the people are its leaders (Judges 20:2; 1 Samuel 14:38). The tent peg holds a tent firm; Isaiah 22:23 calls Eliakim a peg driven into a firm place, on whom his family hangs. The battle bow is the leader in war.

decisions.choice: every ruler: every kind of leader
decisions.reason: The word usually means an oppressor or taskmaster, as in 9:8 and Exodus 3:7. Here it seems to mean a ruler in a good sense, one with power to command (Isaiah 60:17 uses it of rulers who bring peace). Some read it as the rulers who will oppress Judah's enemies.

decisions.choice: from Judah (B); From the people of Judah ... a leader like (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced repeats "Judah" for "him" (m1); Readable also says that the pictures are of leaders (m2).

source.text: וְהָי֨וּ כְגִבֹּרִ֜ים בּוֹסִ֨ים בְּטִ֤יט חוּצוֹת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְנִ֨לְחֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ם וְהֹבִ֖ישׁוּ רֹכְבֵ֥י סוּסִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will be like warriors trampling in [the] mud of [the] streets in battle, and they will fight, for Yahweh [is] with them, and they will put to shame riders of horses.

en.L: And they will be like warriors trampling in the mud of [the] streets in battle; \q and they will fight, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] with them, \q and they will put to shame [the] riders on horses.
en.B: They will be like warriors in battle, trampling the enemy into the mud of the streets. \q They will fight, \q since {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is with them, \q and the horsemen will be put to shame.
en.R: They will be like soldiers in battle who trample their enemies into the mud of the streets. \q They will fight, \q and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will be with them. \q They will defeat the enemy's horsemen.

es.L: Y serán como guerreros que pisotean en el lodo de [las] calles en la batalla; \q y pelearán, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} [está] con ellos, \q y avergonzarán a [los] jinetes de caballos.
es.B: Serán como guerreros en la batalla, que pisotean al enemigo en el lodo de las calles. \q Pelearán, \q porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} está con ellos, \q y los jinetes quedarán avergonzados.
es.R: Serán como soldados en la batalla que pisotean a sus enemigos en el lodo de las calles. \q Pelearán, \q y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} estará con ellos. \q Derrotarán a los jinetes del enemigo.

fr.L: Et ils seront comme des guerriers qui piétinent dans la boue des rues dans la bataille ; \q et ils combattront, \q car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] avec eux, \q et ils couvriront de honte les cavaliers sur [leurs] chevaux.
fr.B: Ils seront comme des guerriers au combat, qui piétinent l’ennemi dans la boue des rues. \q Ils combattront, \q puisque {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est avec eux, \q et les cavaliers seront couverts de honte.
fr.R: Ils seront comme des soldats au combat qui piétinent leurs ennemis dans la boue des rues. \q Ils combattront, \q et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} sera avec eux. \q Ils vaincront les cavaliers de l’ennemi.

sw.L: Nao watakuwa kama mashujaa wanaokanyaga katika matope ya njia vitani; \q nao watapigana, \q kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [yu] pamoja nao, \q nao watawaaibisha wapanda farasi.
sw.B: Watakuwa kama mashujaa vitani, wakiwakanyaga adui katika matope ya njia. \q Watapigana, \q kwa kuwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} yu pamoja nao, \q na wapanda farasi wataaibika.
sw.R: Watakuwa kama askari vitani wanaowakanyaga adui zao katika matope ya barabarani. \q Watapigana, \q na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atakuwa pamoja nao. \q Watawashinda wapanda farasi wa adui.

vi.L: Họ sẽ như những dũng sĩ giày đạp trong bùn ngoài đường phố nơi chiến trận; \q họ sẽ chiến đấu, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] với họ, \q và họ sẽ làm hổ thẹn những kẻ cưỡi ngựa.
vi.B: Họ sẽ như những dũng sĩ nơi chiến trận, giày đạp quân thù trong bùn ngoài đường phố. \q Họ sẽ chiến đấu, \q vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở với họ, \q và quân kỵ mã sẽ phải hổ thẹn.
vi.R: Họ sẽ như những người lính ra trận giày đạp kẻ thù trong bùn ngoài đường phố. \q Họ sẽ chiến đấu, \q và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ ở với họ. \q Họ sẽ đánh bại quân kỵ mã của kẻ thù.

ko.L: 그들은 싸움터에서 거리의 진흙을 밟는 용사들 같을 것이다. \q 그들이 싸울 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들과 함께 [있기] 때문이다. \q 그들이 말 탄 자들을 부끄럽게 할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들은 전쟁에서 원수를 거리의 진흙 속에 짓밟는 용사들 같을 것이다. \q 그들이 싸울 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들과 함께 있으니, \q 말 탄 자들이 부끄러움을 당할 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 전쟁터에서 원수들을 거리의 진흙 속에 짓밟는 군인들 같을 것이다. \q 그들이 싸울 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 그들과 함께 있을 것이다. \q 그들이 원수의 기마병들을 물리칠 것이다.

decisions.choice: trampling in the mud of the streets: treading down their enemies like mud
decisions.reason: Conquered enemies are pictured as mud trodden down in the streets (2 Samuel 22:43; Micah 7:10). The warriors of Judah trample their foes as easily as they walk through the mud.

decisions.choice: they will fight, for the LORD is with them: the victory is his
decisions.reason: Judah's people fight, but they win because the LORD is with them, as he was with Israel in its battles of old (Joshua 1:5; Judges 6:16).

decisions.choice: the riders on horses: the enemy's cavalry
decisions.reason: Horses and chariots were the strength of great armies, and Judah had little of either (9:10). The foot soldiers of Judah will put the enemy's horsemen to shame, the reverse of what anyone would expect (Psalm 20:8).

decisions.choice: trampling the enemy into the mud (B); their enemies; the enemy's horsemen (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the object of "trampling" (m1). Readable says "defeat" for "put to shame" and names the horsemen as the enemy's (m3).

source.text: וְגִבַּרְתִּ֣י׀אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶת־בֵּ֤ית יוֹסֵף֙ אוֹשִׁ֔יעַ וְהֽוֹשְׁבוֹתִים֙ כִּ֣י רִֽחַמְתִּ֔ים וְהָי֖וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־זְנַחְתִּ֑ים כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶעֱנֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will strengthen [the] house of Judah, and [the] house of Joseph I will save; and I will bring them back, for I have compassion on them, and they will be as [if] I had not rejected them; for I [am] Yahweh their God, and I will answer them.

en.L: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, and the house of Joseph I will save; \q and I will bring them back, for I have had compassion on them, \q and they will be as [if] I had not spurned them; \q because I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and I will answer them.
en.B: I will make the house of Judah strong and save the house of Joseph. \q I will bring them back, because I have compassion on them, \q and it will be as if I had never cast them off. \q I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and I will answer them.
en.R: I will make the people of Judah strong, and I will rescue the northern tribes of Israel. \q I will bring them home, because I feel deep love for them. \q It will be as if I had never turned them away. \q I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and I will answer when they call to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

es.L: Y fortaleceré la casa de Judá, y a la casa de José salvaré; \q y los haré volver, porque he tenido compasión de ellos, \q y serán como [si] no los hubiera desechado; \q porque yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, y les responderé.
es.B: Haré fuerte a la casa de Judá y salvaré a la casa de José. \q Los haré volver, porque tengo compasión de ellos, \q y será como si nunca los hubiera rechazado. \q Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, y les responderé.
es.R: Haré fuerte al pueblo de Judá y rescataré a las tribus del norte de Israel. \q Los traeré de vuelta a casa, porque siento un gran amor por ellos. \q Será como si nunca los hubiera alejado. \q Yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios, y les responderé cuando {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} llamen.

fr.L: Et je fortifierai la maison de Juda, et la maison de Joseph, je la sauverai ; \q et je les ramènerai, car j’ai eu compassion d’eux, \q et ils seront comme [si] je ne les avais pas rejetés ; \q car je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et je leur répondrai.
fr.B: Je rendrai forte la maison de Juda et je sauverai la maison de Joseph. \q Je les ramènerai, parce que j’ai compassion d’eux, \q et ce sera comme si je ne les avais jamais rejetés. \q Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et je leur répondrai.
fr.R: Je rendrai fort le peuple de Juda et je délivrerai les tribus du nord d’Israël. \q Je les ramènerai chez eux, car je les aime profondément. \q Ce sera comme si je ne les avais jamais repoussés. \q Je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et je leur répondrai quand ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appelleront.

sw.L: Nami nitaitia nguvu nyumba ya Yuda, na nyumba ya Yusufu nitaiokoa; \q {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawarudisha, kwa maana nimewahurumia, \q nao watakuwa kana kwamba sikuwakataa; \q kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawajibu.
sw.B: Nitaifanya nyumba ya Yuda kuwa na nguvu na kuiokoa nyumba ya Yusufu. \q Nitawarudisha, kwa sababu ninawahurumia, \q na itakuwa kana kwamba sikuwatupa kamwe. \q Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawajibu.
sw.R: Nitawafanya watu wa Yuda kuwa na nguvu, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitayaokoa makabila ya kaskazini ya Israeli. \q Nitawarudisha nyumbani, kwa sababu ninawapenda sana. \q Itakuwa kana kwamba sikuwahi kuwafukuza. \q Mimi ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitawajibu watakaponiita.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cho nhà Giu-đa mạnh mẽ, và nhà Giô-sép {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải cứu; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem họ về, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thương xót họ, \q và họ sẽ như thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa từng ruồng bỏ họ; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời họ.
vi.B: Ta sẽ làm cho nhà Giu-đa vững mạnh và giải cứu nhà Giô-sép. \q Ta sẽ đem họ về, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thương xót họ, \q và mọi sự sẽ như thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa hề loại bỏ họ. \q Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời họ.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho dân Giu-đa mạnh mẽ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ giải cứu các chi tộc phía bắc của Y-sơ-ra-ên. \q Ta sẽ đưa họ về quê hương, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} thương họ sâu xa. \q Mọi sự sẽ như thể {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} chưa bao giờ xua đuổi họ. \q Ta là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đáp lời khi họ kêu cầu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 내가 유다 집을 강하게 하고, 요셉 집을 내가 구원하겠다. \q 내가 그들을 돌아오게 하겠다. 내가 그들을 불쌍히 여겼기 때문이다. \q 그들은 내가 그들을 버린 적이 없었던 것처럼 될 것이다. \q 나는 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이니, 내가 그들에게 응답하겠다.
ko.B: 내가 유다 집을 강하게 하고 요셉 집을 구원하겠다. \q 내가 그들을 불쌍히 여기니, 그들을 다시 데려오겠다. \q 그러면 내가 그들을 내버린 적이 없었던 것처럼 될 것이다. \q 나는 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}다. 내가 그들에게 응답하겠다.
ko.R: 내가 유다 백성을 강하게 하고, 북쪽 이스라엘 지파들을 구해 내겠다. \q 내가 그들을 깊이 사랑하니, 그들을 고향으로 데려오겠다. \q 내가 그들을 한 번도 내쫓은 적이 없었던 것처럼 될 것이다. \q 나는 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}다. 그들이 나를 부르면 내가 대답하겠다.

decisions.choice: the house of Joseph: the northern tribes of Israel
decisions.reason: Joseph was the father of Ephraim and Manasseh, the largest of the northern tribes. "The house of Joseph" stands for the northern kingdom, also called Ephraim (verse 7), whose people had been carried off by Assyria. Judah and Joseph together are the whole people (Ezekiel 37:16-19).

decisions.choice: I will bring them back: one of two readings combined in the written form
alternatives: I will settle them (in their land)
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew form looks like a blend of two verbs: "I will bring them back" and "I will make them dwell". The reading tradition and most ancient translations take the first, which is followed here, as in verse 10. The second would mean "I will settle them" in their land. Either way the LORD restores his people.

decisions.choice: I have compassion on them ... as though I had not rejected them: a full restoring
decisions.reason: The verb for compassion is the tender love of a parent (Psalm 103:13); it is the word in the name of Hosea's daughter Lo-ruhamah (Hosea 1:6; 2:25). The LORD will take his people back as if he had never cast them off.

decisions.choice: I am the LORD their God, and I will answer them: the covenant bond renewed
decisions.reason: "I am the LORD their God" is the language of the covenant (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:44-45). To "answer" is to hear prayer and act on it (13:9; Isaiah 58:9).

decisions.choice: the northern tribes of Israel; I feel deep love for them; I will answer when they call to me (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the house of Joseph" (m1) and "answer" (m4). The LORD is speaking of himself, so "me" takes the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: "nyumba ya Yusufu" (L, B); "makabila ya kaskazini ya Israeli" (R)
decisions.reason: Joseph keeps the published Genesis form "Yusufu"; Readable explains the name, as the English Readable does (meaning decision m1).

source.text: וְהָי֤וּ כְגִבּוֹר֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְשָׂמַ֥ח לִבָּ֖ם כְּמוֹ־יָ֑יִן וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ יִרְא֣וּ וְשָׂמֵ֔חוּ יָגֵ֥ל לִבָּ֖ם בַּיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will be like a warrior Ephraim, and will rejoice their heart as [with] wine; and their children will see and rejoice; will rejoice their heart in Yahweh.

en.L: And Ephraim will be like a warrior, \q and their heart will be glad as [with] wine; \q and their children will see [it] and be glad; \q their heart will rejoice in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The people of Ephraim will be like warriors, \q and their hearts will be glad as if with wine. \q Their children will see it and be glad; \q their hearts will rejoice in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The people of Ephraim will be like strong soldiers. \q They will be as happy as people who have drunk wine. \q Their children will see it and be glad. \q Their hearts will be full of joy in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y Efraín será como un guerrero, \q y se alegrará su corazón como [con] el vino; \q y sus hijos [lo] verán y se alegrarán; \q su corazón se regocijará {{divine_name:en el SEÑOR|en Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los de Efraín serán como guerreros, \q y su corazón se alegrará como con el vino. \q Sus hijos lo verán y se alegrarán; \q su corazón se regocijará {{divine_name:en el SEÑOR|en Yahvé}}.
es.R: El pueblo de Efraín será como soldados valientes. \q Estarán tan contentos como quien ha bebido vino. \q Sus hijos lo verán y se alegrarán. \q Su corazón se llenará de alegría {{divine_name:en el SEÑOR|en Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Éphraïm sera comme un guerrier, \q et leur cœur se réjouira comme [par] le vin ; \q et leurs enfants [le] verront et se réjouiront ; \q leur cœur exultera {{divine_name:dans le SEIGNEUR|en Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ceux d’Éphraïm seront comme des guerriers, \q et leur cœur se réjouira comme sous l’effet du vin. \q Leurs enfants le verront et se réjouiront ; \q leur cœur exultera {{divine_name:dans le SEIGNEUR|en Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Le peuple d’Éphraïm sera comme des soldats courageux. \q Ils seront aussi joyeux que des gens qui ont bu du vin. \q Leurs enfants le verront et seront heureux. \q Leur cœur sera rempli de joie {{divine_name:dans le SEIGNEUR|en Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na Efraimu atakuwa kama shujaa, \q na moyo wao utafurahi kama [kwa] divai; \q na watoto wao wataona na kufurahi; \q moyo wao utashangilia katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Watu wa Efraimu watakuwa kama mashujaa, \q na mioyo yao itafurahi kama kwa divai. \q Watoto wao wataliona na kufurahi; \q mioyo yao itashangilia katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu wa Efraimu watakuwa kama askari hodari. \q Watakuwa na furaha kama watu waliokunywa divai. \q Watoto wao wataliona hilo na kufurahi. \q Mioyo yao itajaa furaha katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ép-ra-im sẽ như một dũng sĩ, \q và lòng họ sẽ vui mừng như [uống] rượu; \q con cái họ sẽ thấy và vui mừng; \q lòng họ sẽ hớn hở trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Dân Ép-ra-im sẽ như những dũng sĩ, \q và lòng họ sẽ vui mừng như được uống rượu. \q Con cái họ sẽ thấy điều đó và vui mừng; \q lòng họ sẽ hớn hở trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Dân Ép-ra-im sẽ như những người lính mạnh mẽ. \q Họ sẽ vui như người vừa uống rượu. \q Con cái họ sẽ thấy và vui mừng. \q Lòng họ sẽ tràn ngập niềm vui trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 에브라임은 용사 같을 것이며, \q 그들의 마음은 포도주로 [마신 듯] 기쁠 것이다. \q 그들의 자녀들이 보고 기뻐하며, \q 그들의 마음이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 안에서 즐거워할 것이다.
ko.B: 에브라임 사람들은 용사들 같고, \q 그들의 마음은 포도주를 마신 듯 기쁠 것이다. \q 그들의 자녀들도 그것을 보고 기뻐하며, \q 그들의 마음이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 안에서 즐거워할 것이다.
ko.R: 에브라임 백성은 힘센 군인들 같을 것이다. \q 그들은 포도주를 마신 사람들처럼 즐거워할 것이다. \q 그들의 자녀들도 그것을 보고 기뻐할 것이다. \q 그들의 마음이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 안에서 기쁨으로 가득할 것이다.

decisions.choice: Ephraim: the northern tribes, as the house of Joseph in verse 6
decisions.reason: Ephraim was the leading tribe of the north, and its name stands for the northern kingdom, as often in Hosea. The scattered northern tribes are to share in the victory and joy of Judah.

decisions.choice: their heart will be glad as with wine: a great and open joy
decisions.reason: Wine "gladdens the heart" (Psalm 104:15). The joy of the restored people is like the joy of a feast, and it passes to their children, who see what the LORD has done.

decisions.choice: The people of Ephraim (B, R); their hearts (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of Ephraim as one warrior with one heart. Balanced and Readable say "the people of Ephraim" and use plurals, as English does for a people.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:dans le SEIGNEUR|en Yahvé}}"
decisions.reason: French says "dans" before the article and "en" before the bare name, so the span takes in the preposition, as in the published Psalms.

source.text: אֶשְׁרְקָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם וַאֲקַבְּצֵ֖ם כִּ֣י פְדִיתִ֑ים וְרָב֖וּ כְּמ֥וֹ רָבֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I will whistle for them and I will gather them, for I have redeemed them; and they will be many as they were many.

en.L: I will whistle for them and I will gather them in, for I have redeemed them; \q and they will become as many as they were before.
en.B: I will whistle for them and gather them in, because I have set them free, \q and they will be as many as they were before.
en.R: I will whistle to call them together and gather them, because I have rescued them. \q There will be as many of them as there were before.

es.L: Les silbaré y los reuniré, porque los he redimido; \q y serán tantos como eran antes.
es.B: Les silbaré y los reuniré, porque los he liberado, \q y serán tan numerosos como antes.
es.R: Silbaré para llamarlos y reunirlos, porque los he rescatado. \q Volverán a ser tantos como eran antes.

fr.L: Je sifflerai pour eux et je les rassemblerai, car je les ai rachetés ; \q et ils seront aussi nombreux qu’ils l’étaient auparavant.
fr.B: Je les appellerai d’un sifflement et je les rassemblerai, car je les ai libérés, \q et ils seront aussi nombreux qu’autrefois.
fr.R: Je sifflerai pour les appeler et les rassembler, car je les ai délivrés. \q Ils seront aussi nombreux qu’avant.

sw.L: Nitawapigia mluzi na kuwakusanya, kwa maana nimewakomboa; \q nao wataongezeka kama walivyokuwa wameongezeka zamani.
sw.B: Nitawapigia mluzi na kuwakusanya, kwa sababu nimewaweka huru, \q nao watakuwa wengi kama walivyokuwa zamani.
sw.R: Nitawapigia mluzi ili kuwaita pamoja na kuwakusanya, kwa sababu nimewaokoa. \q Watakuwa wengi kama walivyokuwa zamani.

vi.L: Ta sẽ huýt gió gọi họ và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm họ lại, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã cứu chuộc họ; \q họ sẽ đông đúc như họ đã từng đông đúc trước kia.
vi.B: Ta sẽ huýt gió gọi họ và nhóm họ lại, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giải phóng họ, \q và họ sẽ đông như trước kia.
vi.R: Ta sẽ huýt gió để gọi họ đến và nhóm họ lại, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã giải cứu họ. \q Họ sẽ đông đúc như trước kia.

ko.L: 내가 휘파람을 불어 그들을 모으겠다. 내가 그들을 구속하였기 때문이다. \q 그들이 전에 많았던 것처럼 많아질 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 휘파람을 불어 그들을 모으겠다. 내가 그들을 구속하였기 때문이다. \q 그들이 전처럼 많아질 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 휘파람을 불어 그들을 불러 모으겠다. 내가 그들을 구해 냈기 때문이다. \q 그들이 전처럼 많아질 것이다.

decisions.choice: I will whistle for them: the signal that calls them together
decisions.reason: A shepherd or beekeeper whistled to call his flock or his bees (Judges 5:16). Isaiah 5:26 and 7:18 use the same verb of the LORD whistling for the nations to come against his people. Now he whistles to bring his own people home.

decisions.choice: I have redeemed them: set them free, as from slavery
decisions.reason: The verb means to ransom or set free by paying a price, and it is used for the LORD's freeing of Israel from Egypt (Deuteronomy 7:8; 13:6). Here the freeing has been decided already, though the gathering is still to come.

decisions.choice: as many as they were before: as they grew in Egypt
decisions.reason: The people will grow again to their former numbers. The words recall how Israel multiplied in Egypt (Exodus 1:7, 12) and the promise to Abraham of descendants beyond counting (Genesis 22:17).

decisions.choice: before (L, B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "they will be many as they were many". Every level says "as many as they were before", and Literal leaves the word unbracketed because it only puts the repeated verb into English.

decisions.choice: "nitawapigia mluzi"
decisions.reason: The whistle of a herdsman calling his animals (meaning decision m1) is "kupiga mluzi" in Swahili, so every level keeps the picture.

source.text: וְאֶזְרָעֵם֙ בָּֽעַמִּ֔ים וּבַמֶּרְחַקִּ֖ים יִזְכְּר֑וּנִי וְחָי֥וּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם וָשָֽׁבוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will sow them among [the] peoples, and in far places they will remember me; and they will live with their children and return.

en.L: Though I sow them among [the] peoples, \q yet in far places they will remember {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q and they will live with their children and return.
en.B: Though I scatter them among the peoples like seed, \q in faraway lands they will remember {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q they and their children will live, and they will come back.
en.R: I will scatter them among the nations like seed, \q but even in faraway lands they will remember {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q They and their children will stay alive, and they will come home.

es.L: Aunque los siembre entre [los] pueblos, \q en lugares lejanos se acordarán de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q y vivirán con sus hijos y volverán.
es.B: Aunque los esparza como semilla entre los pueblos, \q en tierras lejanas se acordarán de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q ellos y sus hijos vivirán, y volverán.
es.R: Los esparciré como semilla entre las naciones, \q pero aun en tierras lejanas se acordarán de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Ellos y sus hijos seguirán con vida, y volverán a casa.

fr.L: Quand je les sèmerai parmi [les] peuples, \q dans les lieux lointains ils se souviendront de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q et ils vivront avec leurs enfants, et ils reviendront.
fr.B: Même si je les disperse comme une semence parmi les peuples, \q dans des pays lointains ils se souviendront de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q eux et leurs enfants vivront, et ils reviendront.
fr.R: Je les disperserai parmi les nations comme on sème des graines, \q mais même dans des pays lointains, ils se souviendront de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Eux et leurs enfants resteront en vie, et ils reviendront chez eux.

sw.L: Ingawa nitawapanda kati ya mataifa, \q katika nchi za mbali watanikumbuka; \q nao wataishi pamoja na watoto wao na kurudi.
sw.B: Ingawa nitawatawanya kati ya mataifa kama mbegu, \q katika nchi za mbali watanikumbuka; \q wao na watoto wao wataishi, nao watarudi.
sw.R: Nitawatawanya kati ya mataifa kama mbegu, \q lakini hata katika nchi za mbali watanikumbuka. \q Wao na watoto wao wataendelea kuishi, nao watarudi nyumbani.

vi.L: Dù {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} gieo họ giữa các dân, \q thì ở những nơi xa xôi họ sẽ nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q họ sẽ sống cùng con cái mình và trở về.
vi.B: Dù {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} rải họ ra giữa các dân như gieo hạt, \q ở những xứ xa xôi họ vẫn sẽ nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q họ và con cái họ sẽ sống, và họ sẽ trở về.
vi.R: Ta sẽ rải họ ra giữa các nước như gieo hạt giống, \q nhưng dù ở những xứ xa xôi họ vẫn sẽ nhớ đến {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Họ và con cái họ sẽ được sống, và họ sẽ trở về quê hương.

ko.L: 내가 그들을 민족들 가운데 뿌릴지라도, \q 먼 곳에서 그들이 나를 기억할 것이며, \q 그들이 자녀들과 함께 살아서 돌아올 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 그들을 씨처럼 민족들 가운데 흩을지라도, \q 그들은 먼 땅에서 나를 기억할 것이다. \q 그들과 그 자녀들이 살아남아 돌아올 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 그들을 씨를 뿌리듯 여러 나라에 흩을 것이다. \q 그러나 그들은 먼 땅에서도 나를 기억할 것이다. \q 그들과 그 자녀들은 살아남아 고향으로 돌아올 것이다.

decisions.choice: sow them among the peoples: scatter them, as seed that will grow
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for sowing seed. The LORD's scattering of his people among the nations is pictured as sowing, which looks forward to a harvest; Hosea 2:25 uses the same verb of the LORD sowing his people in the land. The scattering is not the end of them.

decisions.choice: though I sow them ... yet they will remember me: the scattering and the remembering together
alternatives: I scattered them among the peoples, but ...
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the two clauses with "and". The sense is that even when they are scattered far away, they will remember the LORD and turn back to him (Deuteronomy 30:1-3; 1 Kings 8:47-48). The verb may be read of a scattering still to come or of the one that had already happened; it is read here as the first.

decisions.choice: scatter them ... like seed (B, R); come back, come home (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "scatter ... like seed" to keep both the scattering and the picture of sowing (m1).

source.text: וַהֲשִֽׁיבוֹתִים֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּמֵֽאַשּׁ֖וּר אֲקַבְּצֵ֑ם וְאֶל־אֶ֨רֶץ גִּלְעָ֤ד וּלְבָנוֹן֙ אֲבִיאֵ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יִמָּצֵ֖א לָהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will bring them back from [the] land of Egypt, and from Assyria I will gather them, and to [the] land of Gilead and Lebanon I will bring them, and [room] will not be found for them.

en.L: And I will bring them back from the land of Egypt, \q and from Assyria I will gather them; \q and to the land of Gilead and Lebanon I will bring them, \q and [room] will not be found for them.
en.B: I will bring them home from the land of Egypt \q and gather them from Assyria. \q I will bring them to the land of Gilead and to Lebanon, \q until there is no room left for them.
en.R: I will bring them home from Egypt \q and gather them out of Assyria. \q I will lead them into the lands of Gilead and Lebanon, \q and there will not be enough room for them all.

es.L: Y los haré volver de la tierra de Egipto, \q y de Asiria los reuniré; \q y a la tierra de Galaad y del Líbano los traeré, \q y no se hallará [lugar] para ellos.
es.B: Los traeré de vuelta de la tierra de Egipto \q y los reuniré de Asiria. \q Los llevaré a la tierra de Galaad y al Líbano, \q hasta que no quede lugar para ellos.
es.R: Los traeré de vuelta a casa desde Egipto \q y los reuniré sacándolos de Asiria. \q Los llevaré a las tierras de Galaad y del Líbano, \q y no habrá lugar suficiente para todos.

fr.L: Et je les ramènerai du pays d’Égypte, \q et d’Assyrie je les rassemblerai ; \q et au pays de Galaad et du Liban je les amènerai, \q et [la place] ne se trouvera pas pour eux.
fr.B: Je les ramènerai du pays d’Égypte \q et je les rassemblerai d’Assyrie. \q Je les amènerai au pays de Galaad et au Liban, \q jusqu’à ce qu’il n’y ait plus de place pour eux.
fr.R: Je les ramènerai d’Égypte \q et je les rassemblerai en les faisant sortir d’Assyrie. \q Je les conduirai dans les pays de Galaad et du Liban, \q et il n’y aura pas assez de place pour eux tous.

sw.L: Nami nitawarudisha kutoka nchi ya Misri, \q na kutoka Ashuru nitawakusanya; \q na katika nchi ya Gileadi na Lebanoni nitawaleta, \q wala [nafasi] haitapatikana kwa ajili yao.
sw.B: Nitawarudisha nyumbani kutoka nchi ya Misri \q na kuwakusanya kutoka Ashuru. \q Nitawaleta katika nchi ya Gileadi na Lebanoni, \q hata isibaki nafasi kwa ajili yao.
sw.R: Nitawarudisha nyumbani kutoka Misri \q na kuwakusanya kutoka Ashuru. \q Nitawaongoza mpaka nchi za Gileadi na Lebanoni, \q na nafasi haitawatosha wote.

vi.L: Ta sẽ đem họ về từ đất Ai Cập, \q và từ A-si-ri {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm họ lại; \q và vào đất Ga-la-át và Li-ban {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đưa họ đến, \q và sẽ không tìm được [chỗ] cho họ.
vi.B: Ta sẽ đem họ về từ đất Ai Cập \q và nhóm họ lại từ A-si-ri. \q Ta sẽ đưa họ vào đất Ga-la-át và Li-ban, \q cho đến khi không còn chỗ cho họ nữa.
vi.R: Ta sẽ đưa họ về nhà từ Ai Cập \q và nhóm họ lại từ A-si-ri. \q Ta sẽ dẫn họ vào các miền Ga-la-át và Li-ban, \q và sẽ không đủ chỗ cho tất cả họ.

ko.L: 내가 그들을 이집트 땅에서 돌아오게 하고, \q 앗시리아에서 그들을 모으며, \q 길르앗 땅과 레바논으로 그들을 데려가겠다. \q 그러나 그들을 위한 [자리가] 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 그들을 이집트 땅에서 데려오고 \q 앗시리아에서 모으겠다. \q 그들을 길르앗 땅과 레바논으로 데려가겠다. \q 그들이 살 자리가 남지 않을 만큼 많을 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 그들을 이집트에서 고향으로 데려오고 \q 앗시리아에서 모으겠다. \q 그들을 길르앗과 레바논 땅으로 이끌어 가겠다. \q 그러면 그들이 모두 살기에는 땅이 좁을 것이다.

decisions.choice: Egypt and Assyria: the lands of Israel's oppression and exile
decisions.reason: Egypt was the land of Israel's slavery, and Assyria the empire that carried off the northern tribes. By Zechariah's day Assyria had fallen long before, and the names stand for the lands to the south and to the north-east where Israel's people were scattered (Isaiah 11:11; 27:13; Hosea 11:11).

decisions.choice: Gilead and Lebanon: the lands east of the Jordan and in the north
decisions.reason: Gilead was the land east of the Jordan, rich in pasture, held by Israel's tribes from the time of Moses (Numbers 32). Lebanon was the mountain land in the far north. Together they mark the full extent of the old land of Israel, given back to its people (Micah 7:14; Jeremiah 50:19).

decisions.choice: room will not be found for them: there will be too many people for the land
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "it will not be found for them". The sense is that the land will be too small for the returning people, as Isaiah 49:19-20 promises.

decisions.choice: no room left (B); not enough room for them all (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "room", which Literal brackets (m3).

source.text: וְעָבַ֨ר בַּיָּ֜ם צָרָ֗ה וְהִכָּ֤ה בַיָּם֙ גַּלִּ֔ים וְהֹבִ֕ישׁוּ כֹּ֖ל מְצוּל֣וֹת יְאֹ֑ר וְהוּרַד֙ גְּא֣וֹן אַשּׁ֔וּר וְשֵׁ֥בֶט מִצְרַ֖יִם יָסֽוּר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he will pass through [the] sea of distress, and he will strike in [the] sea [the] waves, and will dry up all [the] depths of [the] Nile; and will be brought down [the] pride of Assyria, and [the] scepter of Egypt will depart.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will cross the sea of distress \q and strike [the] waves in the sea, \q and all the Nile's depths will dry up; \q and Assyria's pride will be brought down, \q and Egypt's scepter will depart.
en.B: He will cross the sea of distress \q and strike down its waves, \q and the Nile will dry up to its depths. \q Assyria's pride will be brought low, \q and Egypt's scepter will pass away.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will go through the sea of trouble \q and strike its waves, \q and the deepest parts of the Nile River will dry up. \q Proud Assyria will be brought down, \q and Egypt will no longer rule.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cruzará el mar de la angustia \q y herirá [las] olas en el mar, \q y se secarán todas las profundidades del Nilo; \q y será abatido el orgullo de Asiria, \q y el cetro de Egipto se apartará.
es.B: Él cruzará el mar de la angustia \q y abatirá sus olas, \q y el Nilo se secará hasta lo más hondo. \q El orgullo de Asiria será humillado, \q y el cetro de Egipto desaparecerá.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} atravesará el mar de la aflicción \q y golpeará sus olas, \q y las partes más profundas del río Nilo se secarán. \q La orgullosa Asiria será derribada, \q y Egipto ya no gobernará.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} traversera la mer de détresse \q et frappera les flots dans la mer, \q et toutes les profondeurs du Nil seront desséchées ; \q et l’orgueil de l’Assyrie sera abattu, \q et le sceptre de l’Égypte s’en ira.
fr.B: Il traversera la mer de détresse \q et abattra ses flots, \q et le Nil sera asséché jusqu’au fond. \q L’orgueil de l’Assyrie sera abaissé, \q et le sceptre de l’Égypte disparaîtra.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} traversera la mer de la souffrance \q et frappera ses vagues, \q et les endroits les plus profonds du Nil seront à sec. \q L’Assyrie orgueilleuse sera abattue, \q et l’Égypte ne dominera plus.

sw.L: Naye atapita katika bahari ya dhiki \q na kuyapiga mawimbi ya bahari, \q na vilindi vyote vya Naili vitakauka; \q na kiburi cha Ashuru kitashushwa, \q na fimbo ya enzi ya Misri itaondoka.
sw.B: Atavuka bahari ya dhiki \q na kuyapiga mawimbi yake, \q na Naili itakauka hadi vilindini mwake. \q Kiburi cha Ashuru kitashushwa chini, \q na fimbo ya enzi ya Misri itatoweka.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atapita katika bahari ya taabu \q na kuyapiga mawimbi yake, \q na sehemu zenye kina kirefu za mto Naili zitakauka. \q Ashuru yenye kiburi itaangushwa, \q na Misri haitatawala tena.

vi.L: Ngài sẽ băng qua biển hoạn nạn \q và đánh các lượn sóng trong biển, \q và mọi vực sâu của sông Nin sẽ khô cạn; \q và sự kiêu ngạo của A-si-ri sẽ bị hạ xuống, \q và cây quyền trượng của Ai Cập sẽ mất đi.
vi.B: Ngài sẽ băng qua biển hoạn nạn \q và đánh tan các lượn sóng, \q và sông Nin sẽ khô cạn đến tận đáy. \q Sự kiêu ngạo của A-si-ri sẽ bị hạ xuống, \q và quyền trượng của Ai Cập sẽ không còn nữa.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ đi qua biển khổ nạn \q và đánh vào các lượn sóng, \q và những chỗ sâu nhất của sông Nin sẽ khô cạn. \q A-si-ri kiêu ngạo sẽ bị đánh đổ, \q và Ai Cập sẽ không còn cai trị nữa.

ko.L: 그가 고난의 바다를 건너가며 \q 바다의 물결을 칠 것이니, \q 나일 강의 깊은 곳이 다 마를 것이다. \q 앗시리아의 교만이 꺾이고, \q 이집트의 왕권이 떠나갈 것이다.
ko.B: 그가 고난의 바다를 건너서 \q 그 물결을 칠 것이니, \q 나일 강이 바닥까지 마를 것이다. \q 앗시리아의 교만이 꺾이고, \q 이집트의 왕권이 사라질 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 고난의 바다를 지나가며 \q 그 물결을 칠 것이다. \q 나일 강의 가장 깊은 곳까지 마를 것이다. \q 교만한 앗시리아가 무너지고, \q 이집트는 더 이상 다스리지 못할 것이다.

decisions.choice: he will pass through the sea and strike the waves: a new crossing of the sea, as at the exodus
decisions.reason: The LORD once divided the sea and dried it up for his people to cross from Egypt (Exodus 14:21-22; Psalm 106:9). The return from exile is pictured as a new exodus, with the LORD going ahead of his people and drying up the waters, as in Isaiah 11:15-16 and 51:10.

decisions.choice: he will pass through: the LORD goes before his people
alternatives: the people will pass through the sea of distress
decisions.reason: The verb is singular. It is read here of the LORD, who strikes the waves and dries up the Nile; the next verse speaks of him again. It may instead refer to the people, spoken of as one, crossing the sea of distress; the Septuagint reads "they will pass through".

decisions.choice: the sea of distress: the sea as a picture of trouble
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is "sea, distress". It is read as "the sea of distress", that is, the sea of trouble the people must cross. A small change in the letters would give "the sea of Egypt", as in Isaiah 11:15.

decisions.choice: the Nile; the pride of Assyria; the scepter of Egypt: the great powers brought low
decisions.reason: The Nile was the life of Egypt; to dry it up is to strike at Egypt's heart (Isaiah 19:5-7). The scepter is the rod of a king's rule. The powers that once ruled over Israel will lose their hold.

decisions.choice: The LORD will go through (R); Proud Assyria; Egypt will no longer rule (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the LORD as the one who acts (m2) and says what the pride and the scepter stand for (m4). Balanced begins its sentence with "He", where the deity_pronoun setting is not needed.

decisions.choice: "그가" (L, B); "주가" (R), with no -시-
decisions.reason: The LORD is the speaker of verses 3-12 (verse 12 "I will strengthen them") and speaks of himself in the third person (meaning decision m2); God takes no honorific in his own mouth.

source.text: וְגִבַּרְתִּים֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And I will strengthen them in Yahweh, and in his name they will walk, declaration of Yahweh.

en.L: And I will make them strong in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name they will walk about, \q declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will give them strength in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and they will walk in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, \q declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: I will make them strong through {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. \q They will live as people who bear {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, \q says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y los fortaleceré {{divine_name:en el SEÑOR|en Yahvé}}, \q y en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre andarán, \q declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Les daré fuerza {{divine_name:en el SEÑOR|en Yahvé}}, \q y andarán en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, \q afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los haré fuertes por medio {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. \q Vivirán como un pueblo que lleva {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre, \q dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et je les rendrai forts {{divine_name:dans le SEIGNEUR|en Yahvé}}, \q et en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ils marcheront, \q déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je leur donnerai la force {{divine_name:dans le SEIGNEUR|en Yahvé}}, \q et ils marcheront en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, \q déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Je les rendrai forts grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. \q Ils vivront comme un peuple qui porte {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, \q dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nami nitawatia nguvu katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} watatembea huku na huko, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitawapa nguvu katika {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nao watatembea katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, \q asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Nitawafanya kuwa na nguvu kupitia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. \q Wataishi kama watu wanaolibeba jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, \q anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ta sẽ làm cho họ mạnh mẽ trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và trong danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} họ sẽ bước đi, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Ta sẽ ban sức mạnh cho họ trong {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và họ sẽ bước đi trong danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho họ mạnh mẽ nhờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. \q Họ sẽ sống như những người mang danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 내가 그들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 안에서 강하게 하겠다. \q 그들이 그의 이름으로 다닐 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 안에서 그들에게 힘을 주겠다. \q 그들이 그의 이름 안에서 살아갈 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 힘입어 그들을 강하게 하겠다. \q 그들은 그의 이름을 지닌 백성으로 살아갈 것이다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: I will strengthen them in the LORD: the LORD speaks of himself by name
decisions.reason: The LORD is speaking, yet he says "in the LORD" and "his name". The prophets sometimes have God speak of himself in the third person in this way (Hosea 1:7; Genesis 19:24). The strength the people will have is the LORD's own.

decisions.choice: walk in his name: live under his authority and in loyalty to him
decisions.reason: To "walk" is to live one's life. To walk in the name of the LORD is to live as his people, trusting in him and obeying him (Micah 4:5). The Septuagint has "they will boast in his name".

decisions.choice: declares the LORD (L, B); says the LORD (R); live as people who bear his name (R)
decisions.reason: The formula follows the wording set in Isaiah. Readable explains "walk in his name" (m2).

decisions.choice: "그의 이름", without -시-
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks of himself in the third person (meaning decision m1), and God takes no honorific in his own mouth.
